PLAYBALL ENGINE CALIBRATION BASELINE
Captured: 2026-08-19
Node: v24.19.0   Engine: JavaScript, pre-TypeScript, pre-bugfix

This is the PRE-FIX baseline. It includes the known walk-off bug (B1) and
the unwired LEAGUE_PITCH constants (B2). Its purpose is to make the
TypeScript port verifiable: the port must reproduce these numbers.
Seeds are fixed, so these figures are exactly reproducible.

matchup                     AVG    SLG    BB%     K%
LHB vs RHP (opposite)     0.279  0.431   11.2   19.3
LHB vs LHP (same)         0.251  0.387    9.9   20.2

Lefty hitter platoon gap: 28 points of AVG
Righty hitter platoon gap: 18 points of AVG
Both should be positive, and the lefty gap clearly larger.

================================================================

=== Parity check, 800 games, log5 engine ===
Elite team (68 rated) vs weak team (38 rated) beat them 95.8% of the time.
Real college baseball: a dominant team beats a bad team roughly 75 to 85 percent.
If you see 95 percent plus, your rating spread is too wide.
